Description: An employee slipped on a wet floor near the staff kitchen and bruised their elbow.
A warehouse worker was struck on the shoulder by a falling box while restocking a high shelf.
A visitor tripped over a loose cable near reception and twisted their ankle.
An operator's hand was pinched between the conveyor belt and the guard rail while clearing a jam.
A driver reported neck strain after braking suddenly to avoid a forklift in the loading bay.
A technician received a minor burn on the forearm while replacing a fuse in the server room.
A cleaner inhaled fumes after two cleaning chemicals were accidentally mixed in a storeroom.
A worker cut their finger on a box cutter while opening a delivery pallet in the warehouse.
An employee felt dizzy and fainted briefly during a heatwave shift on the loading dock.
A contractor fell from the second rung of a stepladder while adjusting ceiling lighting.
A machine operator's sleeve was caught briefly in a rotating spindle before the emergency stop was hit.
An office worker developed wrist pain they attribute to a poorly adjusted keyboard tray.
